races.paceDynamic: Billecart and New Monarch are both confirmed front runners who will engage from flag-fall, creating an honest gallop over this stiff Newcastle mile. With only seven runners, the pace won't be extreme but will be solid enough to stretch the field, particularly as both leaders have the class to sustain their efforts. The prominent runners (Andab, Jel Pepper, Alarming, Timeforshowcasing) will track the leaders closely in this small field, while only Padraig Dawn represents the hold-up contingent. This setup moderately favours prominent runners who can track the pace and strike in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders set steady fractions without killing each other off early
scenarios.body: The prominent trackers get first run on the leaders entering the straight, with class horses like Andab and the returning Jel Pepper able to exploit their superior ratings. Fresh legs prevail over the pace-setters in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Billecart or New Monarch gets an uncontested lead or breaks clear
scenarios.body: The leader gets breathing space mid-race before the field closes, allowing them to kick again when challenged and hold on grimly. New Monarch's recent win or Billecart's higher RPR becomes decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong with both leaders going hard
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final quarter-mile as the leaders tie up, allowing Padraig Dawn to sweep past tired horses with his hold-up style. The lone closer benefits from the pace scenario perfectly suiting his running style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the market principles underperform due to fitness or pace positioning
scenarios.body: A returning horse like Timeforshowcasing or Jel Pepper produces a career-best effort after their break, or Alarming's weight allowance proves decisive. The unusual circumstances create an upset result.

watchPoints.text: New Monarch and Billecart could engage in a pace duel that sets up the race for closers despite the small field
Jel Pepper and Timeforshowcasing both return from long breaks exceeding 180 days, fitness could be compromised despite their class
Andab carries top weight of 133lbs but has the highest RPR rating and Joseph O'Brien has been among the winners recently
Padraig Dawn is the only confirmed hold-up horse so needs the pace to be strong enough to bring tired horses back to him
The going report shows consistent standard times across all distances, suggesting fair racing conditions with no bias

races.paceDynamic: Silent Strike, Sparksmith, and Northern Empire will ensure a genuine gallop from the off, with six others (Monarch's Gold, Jungle Ruler, One And Gone, Eternal Solace, Three Non Blondes, Saffron Dandy) wanting prominent positions creating early congestion. The strong early pace will string the field out by halfway, with the front rank likely to weaken from 2f out as stamina tells at this trip. The genuine gallop and inevitable pace collapse sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to sweep through late. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — Ten Carat Harry, Cotai Lights, Rogue Supremacy and Al Najashi can sit off the early burn and pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is as strong as expected and the leaders tire from 2f out
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get the perfect setup with plenty of pace to aim at and a collapsing field ahead of them. Ten Carat Harry's brilliant 6f form and Al Najashi's four-timer both suit this tactical scenario perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can avoid the early scrimmaging and get a smooth run
scenarios.body: Jungle Ruler or Three Non Blondes could get the right trip just behind the pace setters and have enough left to hold off the closers. Their class and recent form suggests they can handle a tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is so strong that even the prominent horses are compromised
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to the hold-up horses in the final furlong creating a blanket finish. Cotai Lights' recent proximity to form and Rogue Supremacy's Hollie Doyle booking could prove decisive in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Silent Strike or Sparksmith can avoid the early battle and get an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: A tactical front runner could steal a march if the pace settles more than expected and they're not pressed early. Silent Strike's Oisin Murphy booking suggests connections expect him to be competitive from the front.

races.paceDynamic: Shallow is the only confirmed front runner and will set an uncontested lead through honest fractions without pressure. Carolina Jetstream, Callianassa, Paris Babe and Indigo Dream will sit prominent but none are keen pace-pressers, allowing Shallow to dictate comfortable sectionals. The majority are hold-up horses (Stateira, Powdering, Fouette, Bridget's View, Ziggy's Queen, Brazilian Rose) who will be tracking in behind, creating a bunched field turning for home. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be steady and sustainable, setting up a sprint finish where the closers can unleash their turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Shallow sets modest fractions without early pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the early positioned horses to sustain their kick, while the hold-up brigade get perfect conditions to deliver late runs. Stateira and Ziggy's Queen can unleash superior finishing speed from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet apply more pressure than expected, creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: Carolina Jetstream and Paris Babe benefit from sitting closer to stronger gallop, getting first run on the closers who face a stiffer task. Their tactical positioning proves decisive in a more truly-run affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shallow stays prominent
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of pace pressure allows Shallow to maintain her lead deep into the straight
scenarios.body: Her light weight and uncontested lead give her enough rope to hold off late challengers who leave their runs too late. The 7f trip suits her front-running style perfectly on the flat Newcastle track.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Form horses clash
scenarios.trigger: If the highest-rated performers on recent form (Carolina Jetstream, Stateira) both hit peak form simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a straight battle between the in-form prominent runner and the class hold-up act, with both overcoming their contrasting tactical styles. Superior ability trumps race shape considerations.

races.paceDynamic: Flight Plan is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the outset, likely setting a steady, sustainable gallop without pressure from early rivals. The majority of this field are hold-up merchants (Apiarist, Nikovo, Witch Hunter, Tyrrhenian Sea, Popmaster, Rogue Encore, Dosman, Shafdar) with only a handful willing to race prominently (Chancellor, Storm Star, Blue Rc, First Principle, The Lost King). This creates a tactical setup where Flight Plan can control the tempo before the back markers launch their challenges in the final two furlongs. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace will stretch the field and create opportunities for closers to pick off the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Flight Plan sets a true gallop and the prominent racers get involved early
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will string out the field and allow the quality closers to time their runs perfectly in the final furlong. Horses like Witch Hunter and Tyrrhenian Sea can unleash their finishing kicks when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Chancellor and Blue Rc press Flight Plan early and create a strong tempo
scenarios.body: The early pressure forces Flight Plan to go faster than ideal, setting up the race for horses that can track the pace and kick clear before the hold-up horses arrive. Chancellor's Gosden form and Blue Rc's consistency make them prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Flight Plan gets an easy time in front with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: A sedate tempo allows Flight Plan to save energy for a sustained kick, while any prominent racer who moves early can steal a march on the hold-up horses. The lack of pace negates the closers' advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If multiple jockeys make early moves to prevent Flight Plan getting away with murder
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with several horses vying for position, creating a stop-start gallop that suits versatile performers. Experienced jockeys like Jamie Spencer can navigate the chaos best.

The pace will be steady rather than fierce, allowing the field to stay bunched into the straight. scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Valiant Force gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter controls the tempo completely and has enough left to resist late challenges. Hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the lack of genuine pace and can't reel in the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate and prominent runners get first run

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens unexpectedly or Valiant Force stops
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop suits the closers who have been patiently waited with. Ferrous and Marshman emerge from the pack to collar the leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the field remains tightly bunched to the final furlong
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a cavalry charge finish where luck in running decides the outcome. Any horse with a clear run and finishing kick can prevail.

races.paceDynamic: Gaucher, Antrim, and Midnight Lion will ensure a genuinely strong gallop from the outset in this 1m2f handicap. With three confirmed front-runners committed to making the running, the early pace will be honest and sustained, stretching the field and testing stamina reserves over the extended trip. The strong gallop will create a searching test that should bring the best out of horses with proven stamina and tactical speed. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine and those tracking the leaders will have every opportunity to mount late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses flourish
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace will suit closers who can quicken off the strong tempo, with stamina-proven handicappers having ideal conditions to unleash finishing kicks. Late runners with proven class like Teumessias Fox and Paradias can capitalize on the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Sax Appeal sets a moderate pace and the field arrives bunched for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows closers to conserve energy and unleash finishing kicks. Duke Of Oxford, Enemy, and Artisan Dancer all have strong recent form and will relish the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Sax Appeal gets easy fractions and stays on strongly in the straight
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead allows Sax Appeal to build momentum and hold off late challengers. His recent good form and first-time blinkers suggest improvement.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners positions perfectly and kicks at the right time
scenarios.body: Tryfan or Berkshire Sundance could sit handy and time their run to perfection. Both have tactical speed and strong recent form to capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and multiple horses make their moves simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where anything can happen and outsiders can capitalise. Form becomes less relevant in a slowly-run lottery finish.

watchPoints.text: Sax Appeal could steal this if allowed to dictate fractions uncontested - watch for how quickly the prominent runners let him go
Duke Of Oxford with first-time tongue-tie and strong recent form could be hard to peg back if getting the right tactical race
Berkshire Sundance returning after 62 days but Oisin Murphy wouldn't take the ride without stable confidence in his fitness
Enemy and Beylerbeyi both have first-time tongue-ties from Ian Williams who is in good form - stable making positive changes
Watch the early pace - if Sax Appeal goes too slow the race becomes a lottery sprint where outsiders can capitalise
